messages:
rachel: Quick heads-up — third-party pen test booked for next Thu targeting staging. We should carve out a short "quiet window" for aggressive scans and agree scope for KMS read access. Proposed: Thu 10:00-13:00 PDT. Any major blockers?

sam: Ack. Need to confirm: will they require decrypt access or just metadata/listing?

maya: They only asked for ability to call Encrypt/Decrypt for a test key in staging. We should give ephemeral role only to that key and monitor CloudTrail.

lena: +1 on ephemeral. I can own the role issuance and watch logs during the window. Recommend TTL 1h, scoped to arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/staging-pen-test-key and deny key policy changes.

platform-eng: Can we do an ephemeral assume-role flow via AWS STS? Example CLI for testers:
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456:role/pen-test-stager --role-session-name pt-session --duration-seconds 3600
```
We'll provision the role via terraform in the infra repo and gate via a small PR.

rachel: Perfect. Add that role to the infra PR and tag me for review. Also we need to ensure audit logs are preserved and exported to the secure bucket with immutability for 90 days. Who owns the CloudTrail export?

sam: ops team owns trail exports. ops-bot: scheduled export job to s3://audit-exports/staging on Thu 13:05 PDT (automated message).

maya: For evidence collection, please snapshot the following during the window:
- CloudTrail events for kms:Decrypt/Encrypt and iam:AssumeRole
- VPC flow logs for test machines
- App server request logs (trace ids tagged)
We should attach those to the remediation ticket.

lena: I'll run an observability checklist and attach links to the ticket. Also propose a minimal retest plan: once fixes are in, request a 2-hour retest slot within 5 business days. Keep it to the same key + same role for parity.

sam: Regarding RBAC changes, avoid broad policy edits during the window. If a quick mitigation requires role tweaks, do them in a PR and fast-forward approval path (rachel + lena). No emergency wide-allow patches.

platform-eng: Note: batching/auto-scaling won't be affected but we'll post a deploy freeze for staging 09:30-13:30 to reduce noise. Put a short note in releases channel.

rachel: Good call. Also: create one triage ticket per unique finding and tag with "pt-scan" and severity. Use the CVSS guidance in the security runbook.

maya: I'll prepare a small repro template and an evidence packaging checklist. Template will include: steps to reproduce, request/response pairs, traces, and CloudTrail event ids.

lena: Oncall will be paged only for high/critical findings during the window. For medium/low, we collect and triage after the window.

sam: If they attempt noisy key enumeration, we should throttle and push them to a read-only mode. We'll set CloudWatch alarms for >50 kms:Decrypt attempts/min from a single principal.

rachel: Great. To summarize action items:
- platform-eng: terraform role + infra PR (due Tue EOD)
- ops-bot / ops: ensure CloudTrail export and retention (confirm by Wed)
- lena: issue ephemeral creds during window and run obs checklist
- maya: repro template & evidence checklist (due Wed)
- rachel: review infra PR and fast-approve emergency PR path
- sam: create triage board and ticket templates

platform-eng: I'll open the infra PR and drop the link here once ready.

ops-bot: bridge created for pen-test window: https://infra.company/bridges/pen-test-1733008888 (automated message)

rachel: Thanks all — if no objections by EOD tomorrow we'll lock the window and publish the runbook snippet in releases. :thumbsup:

sam: no objections from me.

maya: fine by me.

lena: on it.
